title: Every member is offered 'Install on watch', but the watch app is only on Google Play's test tracks
what: Settings, Phone and watch, Your watch shows 'Install on watch' to anyone whose watch lacks MettleUp, and it opens the watch's Play Store on MettleUp. A code switch says the watch app is on Play. But Play shows the watch app only on its test tracks, with nothing in production. So a normal member who taps Install, or searches the watch Play Store as the app suggests, finds nothing. The MettleUp Plus page also lists 'MettleUp on your watch' as a paid feature.
expected: The install offer and the 'watch' paid feature show only to people who can really get the watch app, until the watch app is live in production on Play.
who: members with a Wear OS watch
how_often: every member with a watch who taps Install
fix_line: Hide the watch install offer for members outside the test groups until the watch app is live for everyone, or publish the watch app to production

title: The MettleUp Plus page does not say the monthly and yearly plans renew by themselves, and has no link to cancel
what: The buy buttons read only the price and 'a month' or 'a year'. The note under them says you pay through Google Play and can cancel there any time. Nothing says the plan renews automatically, and there is no button to open the place in Google Play where a plan is managed or cancelled. Google Play (and Apple, for an iPhone version) ask for both before someone subscribes. The page is behind a switch today.
expected: Before buying, the page says the monthly or yearly plan renews by itself until cancelled, and has a 'Manage or cancel' link that opens the member's subscriptions in Google Play.
how_often: every purchase, once Plus is switched on
fix_line: Add one renewal line under the buttons and a 'Manage or cancel' link to Google Play subscriptions before Plus is switched on
